name: Countdown
description: The days left until a date you choose.
about: A heading and the number of days to go until a date: a holiday, a birthday, a trip. Fill in the title and the date (YYYY-MM-DD) on the phone page; the number changes by itself each day. Before the date it counts down, after it the card says how long ago it was.

options.label: What are you counting down to?
